ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (black) field with sparse high-intensity (white/light grey) pixel clusters; white pixels constitute approximately 5-8% of the visible surface area.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Continuous solid black background across both lobes; discrete light-grey linear streaks and circular/ring-shaped blobs scattered non-uniformly, with a higher density of linear marks on the left lobe.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep, V-shaped acute depression at the central fluke intersection; clearly defined boundaries with a sharp vertex.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serration pattern along the entire trailing edge; multiple peaks and valleys of varying pixel-amplitude (approx. 2-10 pixels depth) most pronounced on the distal margins.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Symmetrical convex curvature on the trailing margins, sweeping upward and outward toward pointed distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Numerous circular and semi-circular light-grey rings distributed across the central and medial regions of both lobes, suggesting healed circular lesions.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Multiple high-contrast, unaligned white/light-grey linear streaks; includes a prominent intersecting diagonal pattern on the mid-left lobe and parallel horizontal streaks on the mid-right lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive surface trauma represented by a dense network of linear rake marks and circular scarring; high-intensity white textural irregularities on the distal tips indicate localized calcified clusters or barnacle colonization.
other_distinctive_markers: Prominent 'X' shaped intersecting linear scars located in the center of the left lobe's ventral surface.
